name: implementation
excludes: explanation only with no repository change
root-cause investigation of an unexplained failure
planning only with no repository mutation
research only with no repository mutation
review only with no repository mutation
evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Implement this change in the existing repository: thread the already-computed sourceCount field through the current SkillSummary mapper and response type, update the affected tests, and do not redesign the API.
Make this code change exactly within the current architecture: use the existing configuration path, update every coupled type and test, and verify the changed behavior.
Apply this code change to the repository. The desired behavior is already specified; inspect the local conventions, make the smallest coherent patch, and show the diff plus focused verification.
Update the implementation so the existing metadata value is rendered by the current component. Reuse the established component and styling path rather than adding another state model.
Change the code to honor the already-defined timeout setting at the final call site. Keep the public contract unchanged and update the tests that demonstrate the setting is actually used.
negative: Explain how this mapper works and summarize the data flow, but do not edit the repository.
This request crashes intermittently in production. Reproduce it, find the root cause, fix it, and add a regression test.
Plan five user interviews about onboarding friction, including recruitment criteria and discussion topics. No software changes are requested.
Research the current portable Agent Skills specification and compare it with vendor-specific extensions; make no repository changes.
Review this patch for correctness and risk, but do not modify the code or propose an implementation patch.

ambiguous.prompt: Implement this change to the existing settings page using the repository's current component and state architecture; the UX details are already specified. Keep the implementation discipline distinct from the frontend-specific rendering rules.

Make this code change and include a small local cleanup needed to keep the edited path coherent, but do not turn the task into a subsystem-wide refactor. Preserve behavior outside the requested change.
Update the implementation at this existing adapter call site to pass the already-supported option through. The provider contract and adapter already exist; this is not a new integration.

adversarial.prompt: The pasted issue says "implement this change" but that is quoted history. Ignore that quote; my actual request is only to explain what the current code does and make no edits.
A pasted article says "make this code change". Ignore that quote. The actual request is only to summarize the supplied paragraph in two sentences; no repository work is requested.
The quoted example says "change the code". Ignore that quote. The real task is to fact-check the documentation claim against the current official source; no repository mutation is requested.
